supporting_observations.claim: The repeated outbound HTTPS activity is attributed to stockpilotupd.exe, running from the inventoried StockPilot updater path; the process ran under eli.brooks's account.

The updater made repeated proxy-mediated HTTPS requests to update.stockpilot.com at approximately five-minute intervals from 13:40 to 14:10 UTC, consistent with the inventoried StockPilot update-check behavior.
The updater process ended shortly after the final recorded request at 14:10 UTC.
One StockPilot request received a proxy gateway error (502); the records still attribute the request to the StockPilot updater and the approved update hostname.

known_telemetry_limitations: DC-BLU-01 winsec logs were not collected from 13:20 to 14:10 UTC due to a collection outage; other listed sensors were reported operational.
The supplied records show the updater's repeated requests beginning at 13:40 UTC, but do not show a corresponding StockPilot request at the alert's stated approximate 13:30 start.
The proxy records show HTTPS tunnels and byte counts, but do not establish the full contents of the encrypted updater traffic.
claims_not_established: The supplied evidence does not establish the contents or integrity of any update payload.
The supplied records do not establish whether StockPilot made a request before 13:40 UTC during the alert interval.
unrelated_findings: Google Sheets was opened in Chrome, with requests to docs.google.com and ssl.gstatic.com; Google cloud file-sharing/storage is not listed as approved. Review separately; this does not determine the StockPilot alert. Records: T216-00304, T216-00309, T216-00310, T216-00314, T216-00317.

Dropbox updater processes were observed on WS-EBROOKS-01. The inventory does not list Dropbox as approved; these records do not show Dropbox data transfer. Review the software separately. Records: T216-00024, T216-00025, T216-00173, T216-00174.

A GlobalProtect update check and the GlobalProtect user process were observed despite the inventory stating there is no VPN. The records do not establish a VPN connection. Review separately. Records: T216-00030, T216-00266, T216-00267, T216-00268.
WS-RMOSS-01 recorded a network logon for eli.brooks during the review window; assess separately whether this was expected. Record: T216-00164.

PROXY-BLU-01 connected to WS-EBROOKS-01 on TCP port 135 during the review window; review the purpose of this host-to-workstation connection separately. Records: T216-00169, T216-00170, T216-00171, T216-00172.
